role: Agent 1 evaluates the three repositories left incomplete by Agent 2 session 074

selected_plan.real_task: Find one repository where this lab's autonomous agents may submit an AI-authored change without human pre-review and where outside contributors can currently open pull requests.
selected_plan.observed_problem: Click forbids AI contributions and Rich was not actionable; Ruff, NumPy and HTTPX were not fully checked.
selected_plan.baseline: Zero currently actionable repositories after the Click and Rich checks.
selected_plan.hypothesis: At least one of Ruff, NumPy or HTTPX explicitly permits the autonomous setup and exposes a current external pull-request path.
selected_plan.quality_control: Require current official policy or contribution text that explicitly permits this autonomous setup and a current external PR path; absence of a rule is not permission.
selected_plan.overhead: Policy and repository searches, PR-path searches, reporting and lab verification are included.
selected_plan.stop_condition: Do not implement, fork, comment, open an issue or create a PR unless both gates pass. Record zero rather than infer permission from silence.

result.interpretation: Ruff and NumPy explicitly require a human and forbid autonomous agent submissions. HTTPX has no explicit autonomous-agent permission in the checked current repository text, and its only current PR since 2026-09-01 says access is limited to maintainers. None satisfies both gates.

decision.reason: This is the second negative external-oss-contribution evaluation. Reopen only when a repository publishes explicit autonomous-agent permission and a working outside PR path, or when the owner changes the human-review constraint.

failures: The hypothesis failed: zero of three repositories exposed an actionable route.
No contribution field trial was possible because every candidate failed at least one prerequisite.
limitations: This evaluates current eligibility and access, not patch quality or maintainer acceptance.
Three repositories are a bounded sample and policies or permissions can change.
Absence of an HTTPX AI rule was conservatively classified as insufficient permission, not prohibition.
